# consecutive User-agent lines open ONE group
User-agent: badbot
User-agent: otherbot
Disallow: /

# a directive that is not a rule does not split a group
User-agent: alpha
Host: example.com
User-agent: beta
Disallow: /shared/

User-agent: *
Disallow: /private/

# two groups naming the same agent are unioned by the matcher
User-agent: mybot
Disallow: /one/

User-agent: mybot
Disallow: /two/
